modern: It is your duty to leave another man’s wrongful act where it is.
original: It is thy duty to leave another man’s wrongful act there where it is.
notification: It is your duty to leave another man’s wrongful act where it is.
notification_original: It is thy duty to leave another man’s wrongful act there where it is.

explained.summary: Someone else’s wrongdoing is theirs. Leave it with them instead of picking it up and carrying it around as your own grievance.
explained.today: When a driver cuts you up or a friend lets you down, you can choose not to retell it all day. The wrong was done once; you don’t have to keep doing it to yourself.
